verdict.rationale: Kick documents its own export paths for some data: a downloadable year-end Tax Package as a single Excel file, report data synced live into Google Sheets, and a CLI that pulls transactions or financial statements. None of these is documented as a complete account export, so the 'export all my data and leave' story is only glancingly covered. Missing for 10: a documented full-workspace or bulk data export, explicit open formats (CSV/JSON) covering all records (ledger, rules, attachments, audit log), offboarding or migration-out guidance, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
